notes.title: Fight Crab 2 Now Available in Early Access!
notes.content:
Fight Crab 2, the long awaited sequel to Fight Crab, is now available in Early Access!
Fight Crab 2 is a simple but deep fighting game where you flip your opponent over to win. Train your crab and fit it out with weapons, spells, and skills to raise the strongest crustacean ever! 
[previewyoutube=TbGKURdYTew;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2457580/

Play Career Mode by Yourself...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44526104/ecd3788bf1d3273a50a92000b1180e7fce1a472a.gif
Raise a crab however you want and grow alongside it as you fight to the top of the Crab League in the singleplayer Career Mode. You can play ranked matches to climb up the League ranks, exhibition matches against all sorts of funky foes, or become the center of attention in event battles! Once a crab's career is over, it can pass on its skills onto the next crab you raise, or be pitched against other crabs raised by players around the world in online matches. Check out other players' crabs from the rankings and fight against them in Battle Simulation to learn from them and hone your claws.

...Or Play Multiplayer with Friends!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44526104/b1ec4386748b2aab7db2cb3928a0f44fcad1aa52.gif
Fight against players one-on-one in serious ranked matches, or have some casual fun in, you guessed it, casual matches. Fight alongside an ally to defeat powerful foes or beat time limits in challenges, or mess around with friends in room matches that you can lock with passwords and set custom rules for. You can play other modes while waiting for players in another with background matchmaking!

Customize Your Human
The humans can be customized with cool colors and gnarly gear, but also by loading in VRM files or connecting to VRoid Hub. Your rider can be anyone. Anything. Support your crab with style!
※The game must be connected to VRoid Hub in order to display custom avatars in online matches.

We hope you enjoy Fight Crab 2!

Fight Crab 2 features the brand new Career Mode where you raise your very own crab, and crabs you've raised can be used in online multiplayer with up to 5 players to fight with other crabs from all over the world.

notes.title: Crabs, Karate, Yakuza, and Physics: What Makes Fight Crab Great
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=n_n5FFPrZuI;full][/previewyoutube]

Fight Crab is a physics-based 3D fighting action game developed by Nusso of Calappa Games.
In a world ruled over by crabs, become a crab yourself and rise up to become king of the crustacean fighters.

This is a revolutionary fighting action game that has been nominated for the “Innovative Outlaw Award” at BitSummit Volume 6, the “Best Innovation Award” at the Taipei Game Show, and the Kyoto Esports Game Awards.

Features:

 Painstakingly crafted physical simulation of full-body crab movement.
 Freely manipulate your pincers to punch, grab, and more. No precalculated motions; experience “real-life” crab fights.
 Easy to understand yet deep and layered game rules: “Flip your opponent over to win”. Not simply a race to inflict damage, this game requires well-thought out strategy and tactics to win. 
 Featuring realistically simulated actual crab species, as well as a rich variety of hardcore weapons and equipment, such as katanas, maces, scooters, and jet engines.


In the trial version, you can play partway through Stage 1: “Crustacean City” and Stage 2: “Crabby Chivalry, Swords and Shells”.
Experience real hardcore crab battle for yourself.

Game Development:

・The developer, Nusso, is a fish and shellfish freak as well as creator of the Ace of Seafood and Neo Aquarium titles.
During his five years as a game programmer at SEGA, he honed his fighting/battle game skills working in the Yakuza (Ryu ga Gotoku) studio, and after leaving the company he began working on games in which crabs fight it out. He simply could not be satisfied with the confines of humanity.

・As a child, he practiced karate. This made it difficult for him to get used to traditional fighting games, due to the fact that karate has no “command input”, nor does it require one to think about the order in which they execute their moves, etc.
“I want to be able to throw punches more freely, and it’s ridiculous that only certain techniques can be used when your opponent has read your next move.”
One of Nusso’s main goals was to create a game in which he could simulate more realistic fights, similar to the kumite of karate.

・Procedural technology and physics are the biggest factors in allowing for free movement in the game. Fortunately, current game engines are generally equipped with physics engines, and having made it through Japan’s infamous “exam wars” alive, Nusso also possesses a bit of physics knowledge himself.

However, making all of the various crab body parts move using physics calculation, and creating win/loss decision mechanics and game balance appropriate for a competitive game turned out to be far more difficult than he had expected.

This is because all of the various game balance-related parameters had to actually be simulated beforehand to know exactly how they would end up working in practice.

For example, when configuring muscle strength settings for a crab’s legs, it’s impossible to tell just how fast it will run without first making it actually run.
On top of this, there is also the fact that the game contains 23 different variations of crab, each with a different body type. The game also features a power-up system, so personalization of each crab proved to be extremely difficult.

Furthermore, computational complexity had to be scaled back in order to port the game to the Nintendo Switch, and all in all, development took about three years.
There aren’t many game designers out there who would think “Yeah, I’ll take the time and effort to do all this” for a single title.

Be sure to experience this awesomely unique and uniquely awesome game for yourself.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1213750/

---

notes.title: Crustacean Combat Title Fight Crab 2020 PC Version Release Announced!
notes.content:
Dear Fans,

Fight Crab. A 3D fighting game where you are crab, and you fight crab. 

[previewyoutube=n_n5FFPrZuI;full][/previewyoutube]

In a world not our own, the gods gifted the crabs power and intelligence. The crabs rose from the depths and stole humanity’s weapons and conquered the Earth.

The crabs are immortal and do not die by blade or gun, however, there is one crustacean law that is unavoidable.

Those who’s shell touches the land must yield. If a crab was to be flipped onto its back in a fight then it shall lose.

You will set out on a journey to become the mightiest crab, and flip the whole world upside down.

With a full physics engine, engage in crab fights where the only rule is to flip your opponent onto its back.
You can grab them, hit them with swords, shoot them with guns, chains, jet engines you name it.
You can also catch their weapons with your claws or climb up walls in crabby fashion, master these skills to defeat your enemies. With fully procedural animations and true collision detection, enjoy the feeling of becoming a crab that fights other crab.

Coming this Summer to Steam! Add it to your wishlists!

Title: Fight Crab
Genre: Crab
MSRP: $14.99

notes.title: VR Rhythm Game SoundArt released!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/098486e02d1e5d334133ab871585beec0882c8f0.jpg

Dear Fans,

Mercury Studio, a one man studio which created the popular battle racing games Break Arts and Break Arts II is back with SoundArt, a brand new title!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36254969/804e2609c6524af14d3260fbfb77aa27f5724a36.png

Exhilirating Rhythm Action
Hit, sweep and thrust the blocks that come flying towards you in time with the music.
Maneuver your sticks gracefully and rack up points!

Unlimited Stages
Load your own tracks into the game and watch as your favourite tunes become new levels.
Rock and Pop tunes will provide particularly challenging stages! The number of stages si only limited by the size of your music library!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36254969/1a514cf69e837759a7d3f149d11ae883e189cdea.png

Show me, Show you.
Sound Art has a Live Show mode where you can stream and show off your playstyle to a crowd.
With VRM avatar support, with a simple file swap you can play as your favourite avatar.
Also if you're streaming on youtube or twitch, viewer reactions will appear in game so you can connect with your audience!
SoundArt isn't just a game for the one with the VR headset on, it's also for the viewers.

Indie Game Collab Tunes Included!
Tracks from upcoming crustacean battle game Fight Crab by Nussoft and Touhou Luna Nights have been preloaded!

What kind of levels will these tracks become?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/851100/Touhou_Luna_Nights/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36254969/2b6192f189b44110f64fa40a68b084517b3b5c35.png

We hope you enjoy SoundArt, where your performances and music join to become a unique piece of Art.
